# stables.rip

> On-chain stablecoin censorship tracker. Real-time monitoring of USDC and USDT freeze events across Ethereum and TRON.

## What is stables.rip?

stables.rip is a transparency tool that tracks every stablecoin blacklist event on-chain. When Circle (USDC) or Tether (USDT) freezes a wallet address, we detect and record it automatically.

## Data Sources

- Ethereum: USDC and USDT freeze events from Etherscan log API
- TRON: USDT AddedBlackList events from TronGrid API
- Balances verified via on-chain multicall queries
- Synced every 30 minutes

## Key Facts

- Tracks USDC and USDT freezes on Ethereum and TRON
- Thousands of addresses blacklisted across both chains
- Over $1 billion in total frozen value
- Data available since 2020
- Free, open, no signup required

## Features

- Wallet Checker: Check if any Ethereum or TRON address is blacklisted
- Freeze Feed: Real-time stream of the latest freeze events
- Cumulative Chart: Frozen supply over time
- Top Frozen Wallets: Largest frozen balances ranked
- Monthly Statistics: Freeze activity trends by month
- Per-chain and per-asset breakdowns

## API

Public JSON API at https://api.kyc.rip/v1/tools/ban-list

Endpoints:
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list?limit=50&offset=0 — Paginated blacklist with stats
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list?address={addr} — Check specific address
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list/top?limit=30 — Top frozen wallets by balance
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list/latest?limit=15 — Most recent freeze events
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list/monthly — Monthly aggregated freeze activity
- GET /v1/tools/ban-list/chart — Daily cumulative frozen supply time series

## Pages

- / — Main tracker with hero stats, wallet checker, freeze feed, chart, top wallets
- /stats — Detailed statistics: monthly trends, per-chain, per-asset breakdowns
- /blacklist — Educational content: how USDC and USDT freezing works technically
- /faq — 14 frequently asked questions about stablecoin censorship

## How Stablecoin Freezing Works

Stablecoin issuers (Circle for USDC, Tether for USDT) have privileged functions in their smart contracts:
- USDC: blacklist(address) — prevents all transfers to/from the address
- USDT: addBlackList(address) — freezes the address; destroyBlackFunds(address) — can also burn the tokens

Once blacklisted, tokens at that address are permanently non-transferable. There is no public appeals process.
